source_refs: F-TRACE-003.md: proposed-versus-authorized boundary and reviewer gate
findings.finding: P1 explicitly proposes F=(RAM_peak, compute_effort, energy). BKP conservation concerns RAM and compute; window signal energy is not device energy consumption. Absence of a power threshold is not positive authority for an energy objective. TASK-FOM authorizes drafting qualitative energy/resource aims, not accepting an active objective. Draft labels and later objective-authority gate prevent silent elevation.
findings.required_action: Before F becomes binding, authorized sponsor-delegate must explicitly adopt, revise or defer energy as an active objective and record its scope/model. If deferred, revise/version the active vector and comparisons. Reviewer cannot make this decision.

findings.finding: RAM minimization within 2048 bytes has direct qualitative BKP conservation support, but an active Pareto preference is still a new F formalization requiring explicit delegated F disposition. It is not an additional authorized hard limit or an already approved ranking. Adoption within this ceiling need not amend R5.
findings.required_action: Authorized decision maker must explicitly settle the RAM minimization preference and active F coordinates; retain the existing 2048-byte gate separately.

findings.finding: Units and directions are explicit: peak bytes, operation-class counts or target cycles/time per accepted sample, and proposed joules per accepted sample under a defined workload. Workload, cost coefficients, attribution, baseline, lifecycle/fault costs and statistics remain unknown. Peak live RAM includes persistent/scratch/owned stack and callee/library costs with justified overlap. No fabricated measurements appear.
findings.required_action: Fix compatible model, workload/statistics and accounting before numeric comparison; unknown stack/lifetimes remain UNKNOWN. Operation-count reduction cannot establish energy reduction.

findings.finding: Constraints-first evidence-scoped SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/UNKNOWN and proposed Pareto dominance retain missing values, parameter domains and uncertainty. Incompatible workloads and host/target scopes cannot be ranked together. Symbolic results are conditional; target observations are not universal bounds. No scalar weights or overall rankings are invented.
findings.required_action: Preserve UNKNOWN and partial projections; any definition change requires versioned disposition and recomparison. Use the rule only after active objectives and comparison scope are authorized.

findings.finding: Crosswalk covers T002-2 exactness, -3 lifecycle, -4 association, -5 exceptions/faults, -6 RAM/dependency, -7 target/performance and -8 deferred full detection. All remain open. Energy characterization under -7 is conditional support for an energy claim, not a preexisting mandatory power acceptance test.
findings.required_action: Retain R4 criteria/integration as unresolved before whole-detector completion, and obtain whole-detector resource evidence separately at that later boundary.
